bundle.shortDescription: AI writing, chat and image assistant
bundle.longDescription: SmartText AI combines an AI humanizer and text improver, AI chat, twelve writing tools, image generation and local text-similarity analysis in one bilingual (Arabic/English) desktop application. Designed and developed by Ismaiel Almarie.
